description: Angular component for a count widget in the Thingsboard UI, handling display and resizing logic.

classes.name: CountWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for the count widget, managing display, styling, and resize behavior.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, styles, and action detection.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up resize observer if auto-scaling is enabled.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Disconnects resize observer on component destruction.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates displayed value and colors based on latest data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Calculates and applies scaling for responsive layout.
